context: HUFLIT is modernizing its course registration process with a new online course registration system. The student is interviewing the university registrar to understand business needs, constraints, and special cases in the registration workflow.

requirements.text: Students must be able to register for courses online.
requirements.reveal_condition: General question about system purpose or current registration workflow.

requirements.text: The system must enforce prerequisite checking before allowing registration.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about registration rules, student eligibility, or prerequisite checks.

requirements.text: Registration must close two weeks before the semester starts.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about the registration timeline or deadline.

requirements.text: The system must support at least 500 concurrent users during peak registration.
requirements.reveal_condition: Direct question about load, performance, or peak-time behavior.

requirements.text: Professors can override prerequisites for specific students in approved cases.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about exceptions or approved manual overrides.

requirements.text: The system must integrate with the existing financial system to calculate registration-related fees.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about tuition, payment dependencies, or existing systems.

requirements.text: The system must provide a wait-list when a course section is full.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about what happens when a class is already full.

requirements.text: Students with unpaid fees must be blocked from registration until the outstanding balance is cleared.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about blocked registration or financial holds after the fee topic has surfaced.
requires: The system must integrate with the existing financial system to calculate registration-related fees.

requirements.text: The system should meet WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility expectations for students with disabilities.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about accessibility or support for students with disabilities.

requirements.text: Students on academic probation must obtain advisor approval before registering.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about special student status or approval flow.
